units.name: Index finger
units.description: Driven by the standard servo through a printed gear pair (motor gear R-H-08 -> input link R-I-03).

units.name: Middle finger
units.description: Moves together with the ring and little fingers; all three share one micro servo.

units.name: Ring finger
units.description: Linked to the middle finger by coupler link R-H-06.

units.name: Little finger
units.description: Pushed by the finger main coupler link R-H-07 and linked to the ring finger by R-H-05.

units.name: Thumb
units.description: Its own micro servo sits inside the thumb metacarpal; a button switches it open or closed.

units.name: Palm & drive
units.description: Palm base, back cover, motor holder, drive links and the three servos.

units.name: Hand board
units.description: Arduino Micro shield with buttons, jacks and the power switch.

units.name: Wrist unit
units.description: Passive rotation (pronation/supination) with a lock pin and a quick-release ejector.

units.name: Forearm frame & battery
units.description: Main frame halves, battery case and door. The socket for the residual limb attaches here.

units.name: Optional accessories
units.description: Parts for the original optical sensor and an external battery case. Not part of the assembly.

cover.name: Covers & frames
cover.orientation: Largest flat face on the bed

structural.name: Fingers & structural parts
structural.orientation: On its side, so the layers run along the part

precision.name: Links, gears, pins & small parts
precision.orientation: Flat, with pin holes vertical; drill 2 mm holes to size

parts.name: Palm base
parts.note: The main structure of the hand; servos and links mount on it.

parts.name: Shaft stopper B
parts.note: Keeps the finger shafts from sliding out.

parts.name: Shaft stopper A
parts.note: Keeps the finger shafts from sliding out.

parts.name: Ring-little coupler link
parts.note: Passes the drive from the ring finger to the little finger.

parts.name: Middle-ring coupler link
parts.note: Passes the drive from the middle finger to the ring finger.

parts.name: Finger main coupler link
parts.note: Push rod from the micro servo horn to the three-finger linkage.

parts.name: Index motor gear
parts.note: Mounted on the standard servo; meshes with the index input link.

parts.name: Motor holder
parts.note: Bracket that holds the micro servo of the three-finger group.

parts.name: Thumb button
parts.note: Switches the thumb between open and closed.

parts.name: Finger lock button
parts.note: Freezes the three-finger group so only the index moves.

parts.name: Back cover
parts.note: The original file is 79 MB; the web view uses a lighter copy.

parts.name: Index middle-distal phalanx
parts.note: Middle and distal phalanx in one piece (the DIP joint is fixed).

parts.name: Index input link
parts.note: Gear sector on the knuckle shaft, driven by the index motor gear.

parts.name: Index coupler link
parts.note: Joins the input link to the middle-distal phalanx.

parts.name: Index proximal phalanx
parts.note: One of two side plates.

parts.name: Index proximal phalanx cover
parts.note: The second side plate.

parts.name: Middle-distal phalanx
parts.note: Used in the middle, ring and little fingers.

parts.name: Coupler link cover
parts.note: Used in the middle, ring and little fingers.

parts.name: Proximal phalanx
parts.note: One of two side plates; used in three fingers.

parts.name: Proximal phalanx cover
parts.note: The second side plate; used in three fingers.

parts.name: Coupler link
parts.note: Used in the middle, ring and little fingers.

parts.name: Thumb proximal phalanx base
parts.note: Mounts on the thumb servo horn.

parts.name: Thumb metacarpal
parts.note: Houses the thumb micro servo.

parts.name: Pronation lock pin
parts.note: Locks the wrist rotation.

parts.name: Ejector lever
parts.note: Releases the hand from the forearm.

parts.name: Sensor holder
parts.note: Only for the original optical muscle sensor (not needed with EMG electrodes).

parts.name: Sensor plate
parts.note: Only for the original optical muscle sensor.

parts.name: External battery case holder
parts.note: Optional external battery.

parts.name: External battery lock knob
parts.note: Optional external battery.

parts.name: External battery case
parts.note: Optional external battery.

servos.title: Index finger servo
servos.torque: 3.5 kg·cm at 4.8 V, 4.4 kg·cm at 6 V
servos.drives: Index finger, through the index motor gear (R-H-08) and the index input link (R-I-03).

servos.title: Middle, ring & little finger servo
servos.torque: 1.6 kg·cm at 4.8 V, 2.0 kg·cm at 6 V
servos.drives: Middle, ring and little fingers, through the finger main coupler link (R-H-07) and links R-H-06 and R-H-05.
servos.firmware: servoOther - travel 55°, can be locked by the finger lock button

servos.title: Thumb servo
servos.torque: 1.6 kg·cm at 4.8 V, 2.0 kg·cm at 6 V
servos.drives: Thumb proximal phalanx (R-T-01, R-T-02), switched open or closed by the thumb button.
